WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  -- modules that directly depend on legacy-collector package
  SELECT subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = 'package:legacy-collector'
  UNION
  -- modules that depend on already-affected modules
  SELECT mdm.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
),
affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
),
production_services AS (
  SELECT subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_deployed_to_deployment
  WHERE object_id = 'deployment:production'
)
SELECT ps.service_id
FROM production_services ps
JOIN affected_services af ON ps.service_id = af.service_id
ORDER BY ps.service_id
